Candidate 0 is the strongest general starting point: explicit acceptance, bounded workload and visible unclaimed decisions address unreliable commitments with little coordination overhead. Its burden measurement would be stronger if it included execution time.

The other mechanisms are distributed coordination, protected execution time, misunderstanding prevention, delegated authority, prerequisite readiness, contingency activation and recurring routines. Candidate 7 best combines a lightweight general mechanism with explicit handling of stalled or withdrawn commitments, preserved original targets and measurement of total volunteer effort.
